scope: All 19 Flying Wyverns appearing in Monster Hunter: World and Iceborne

policy.variantModel: inherit shared body mechanics, author only observed differences
policy.audio: verified same-monster routes or silence; never cross-monster substitution
policy.flight: persistent only when the World behavior uses sustained flight; leaps and glides remain typed attacks

families.evidence: World Rathian family: grounded fireballs, charges, poisonous somersaults; rare species adds charged blue-flame state.
World Rathalos family: fireballs, claw attacks, glide sweeps, and aerial pressure; rare species adds charged blue-flame state.
World Diablos family: burrow/emerge, horn charges, tail attacks, and rage chains; Black Diablos is faster and more charge-heavy.

families.notes: Straight and wide ice sweeps, aerial kicks and dives; Shrieking Legiana chains rapid airborne ice assaults.
Inflation gates hovering air blasts and body slams; Nightshade replaces pressure zoning with movable sleep clouds.
Scales fall from body attacks and aerial bombing; Seething heats head and tail, then uses purple scales and a diving explosion.
Grounded charge chains, spin finishers, rocks and damaging roars; Brute Tigrex interrupts charges with directional roars.
Crouched leap chains, tail spin/slam, and lingering bleed spikes; enraged tail slam and spin may repeat.

World/Iceborne Barioth is a grounded, highly mobile Flying Wyvern: lateral leaps, short tackles, delayed tail sweeps, wall-cling pounces, gliding pounces, ice-tornado projectiles and a high landing slam. Breaking either foreleg spike causes braking slips after eligible mobility actions; breaking the head weakens accuracy/damage and suppresses iceblight from the tornado; severing the tail shortens the sweep. Exhaustion can make the ice breath fizzle. Frostfang remains a separate variant that adds freezing ground and roots.
